body:
Dear @BenKey please test my fix in PR #11268
Thank you!

@yurybura 
I was not certain how to sync the pull request to my fork.

What I ended up doing is as follows.

1. I replaced ports/llvm/CONTROL with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/vcpkg/1b8eb0c93d9d75378e605542cd8a9ecf28ef0a9b/ports/llvm/CONTROL.
2. I replaced ports/llvm/portfile.cmake with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/vcpkg/1b8eb0c93d9d75378e605542cd8a9ecf28ef0a9b/ports/llvm/portfile.cmake.
3. I then ran the following command.
     vcpkg install llvm llvm[clang-tools-extra] llvm[utils] --triplet x64-windows

The build still failed with the same error. See the following log file.
[install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/files/4619457/install-x64-windows-dbg-out.log)

In _SOURCE_PATH/clang/tools/libclang/CMakeLists.txt_ line 63:
```
find_library(DL_LIBRARY_PATH dl)
if (DL_LIBRARY_PATH)
  list(APPEND LIBS dl)
endif()
```

Does this related?

Dear @BenKey you haven't been used my latest version..
Please apply my last commit from PR #11268 : https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/pull/11268/commits/a6ddd53c8428425f6b13e12e0a1c93375f70ed2f.
Thank you.

> Does this related?

@JackBoosY  I think so yes. I don't want to patch LLVM code. Instead of that I override `DL_LIBRARY_PATH` with empty value using CMake command line (see https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/commit/a6ddd53c8428425f6b13e12e0a1c93375f70ed2f).
@yurybura After adding the other change I tried again. It works! Thanks.
Please keep this issue open before #11268 merged.
